_about: Longer LK5 Pro, stock MK8-style Bowden hotend, 0.3 mm nozzle, PLA, Extra Fast speed tier (250/300 mm/s, accel 2500). Same as the base config, hotter at peak flow.
_flow_points_note: 210 C at ~5 mm3/s (peak flow): an Extra Fast cap at 205 C peak showed slight under-extrusion (2026-11-08). Rest of the print stays ~198-200 C.
_rates_note: From klippy.log: full-power heating ~0.7 C/s and heater-off cooling ~0.35 C/s near 190-210 C. While printing the heater already runs ~74% (peaks 98%), so usable extra heating is much lower.
